intro:
60 seconds to memorize the scene.
Can you find the missing evidence in your mind?
description:
Could your observation and memory rival a master detective's?

"Wait... what color was the sofa?"
"Was there an animal by the window?"
The more you try to recall, the more the scene fades away.

This game is a memory puzzle where you step into a detective's shoes. Memorize each scene for 60 seconds, then answer 4-choice questions about the tiny "evidence" hidden in the details.

Crime scenes, dusty studies, attics, gardens, train compartments…
Burn the details of many different scenes into your memory.

How to play is simple.
・Observe every corner of the screen for 60 seconds
・When the image is masked, answer the 4-choice question
・Get it right and the original scene reappears

The frustration of "I didn't notice that!" and the satisfaction of "Got it!"
Solve the mysteries of all 50 stages with your memory alone.

Quick to play in short sessions, perfect for training observation and memory like a true detective.
Squeeze in some brain exercise on your commute, during a break, or before bed.

Find the missing evidence — in your mind.
Can your memory uncover the truth?

The game supports both button controls and touch controls, allowing you to play in TV mode, handheld mode, or tabletop mode.
